title: Minimum Number of Swaps to Make the String Balanced
description: You are given a 0-indexed even-length string `s` consisting of exactly `n / 2` opening brackets `'['` and `n / 2` closing brackets `']'`. In one swap, you may swap characters at any two indices. Return the minimum number of swaps needed to make `s` a balanced bracket string.
constraints: s.length is even and contains equal numbers of '[' and ']'.
hints: Track the maximum imbalance (the peak excess of ']' over '[' seen at any prefix).
Each optimal swap fixes two units of imbalance, so the answer is (maxImbalance + 1) // 2.

examples.explanation: Swapping index 0 and index 3 turns "][][" into "[[]]" in 1 swap.
Maximum excess of ']' is 3, requiring (3 + 1) // 2 = 2 swaps.
